body: Revolut’s designers had spent seven years documenting how their design system works. Senior Designer Dmytro Pavlov shares how his team used Codex to turn that material into a format AI could read in a single day. Along the way, they spotted gaps in their templates and made the guidance clearer for the designers who use it. Read the full story: https://openai.com/business/customer-stories/revolut/
ar_body:
وثّق مصممو Revolut نظام التصميم لديهم على مدى سبع سنوات.

• استخدم Dmytro Pavlov وفريقه Codex لتحويل المواد إلى صيغة مقروءة للذكاء الاصطناعي في يوم.
• كشفت العملية ثغرات في القوالب.
• صارت الإرشادات أوضح للمصممين.
